senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (द्रबति)
1 To go, to move, to run.
2 To drop.
3 To distil or ooze.
r. 5th cl. (द्रुनुते द्रुनोति)
To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill.
With अनु prefixed,
To pursue, to follow.
With अभि,
To swim, to float, to descend.
With आङ्,
To flee.
With उप,
To oppress, to destroy.
With प्र,
To fly, to retreat, to run away.
With वि,
1 To smite, to kill.
2 To flee, to run away.
With सम् and आङ्,
To run together.
With सम् and उप,
To flee.
2 To meet.

m. (द्रुः)
A tree.
f. (द्रुः)
Going, motion.
E.
द्रु to go (up), to grow, affix डु.

r. 9th cl. (ञ्,) द्रूञ् (द्रूणाति द्रूणीते)
1 To go, to move.
2 To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill.

m. (-द्रूः)
Gold.
E.
द्रु to go, क्विप् affix, and the vowel made long.

n. (-मं)
A tree, a sort of pine: (Pinus devadaru.)
E.
द्रु a tree, किलिम the fir or pine, derived from किल to send or cast, to give out (resin), and किमच् aff.

m. (-णः)
1 A mace, a millet, an iron weapon made like a carpenter's hammer.
2 An axe, a hatchet.
3 A name of BRAHMĀ.
4 A plant: see भूमिचम्पक.
E.
द्रु a tree, हन to injure or demolish, affix अप्, and घन substituted for the radical; न is usually changed to ण, but the word is also written द्रुघन.

m. (-णः)
1 A name of BRAHMĀ.
2 An iron club.
3 A sort of hatchet.
E.
द्रु a tree, हन to strike, affix अप्, घ and ण substituted for ह and न, and the vowel of द्रु made long; also optionally द्रुघण, द्रुघन, and द्रूघन.

r. 1st cl. (द्रुडति)
To sink.

r. 6th cl. (द्रुणति)
1 To hurt, to injure.
2 To go, to move, to approach.
3 To bind, to make crooked or curved.

m. (-णः)
1 A scorpion.
2 A bee.
3 A rogue, a cheat.
f. (-णा)
A bow string.
n. (-णं)
A bow.
2 A sword, a scimitar.
E.
द्रुण to injure, affix क.

m. (-णः)
A scorpion; also द्रुण and द्रोण.

mfn. (-सः-सी-सं)
Large-nosed.
E.
द्रु a tree, and नस for नास a nose.

m. (-हः)
A scabbard, a sword sheath.
E.
द्रुण a sword, हन to kill or remove, affix ड; the word is also द्रुनह.

f. (-णिः-णी)
1 An oval water bason of wood or stone, &c. shaped like a boat, and used for pouring water.
2 A bucket, a basket.
f. (-णी)
1 A centipede.
2 A small or female tortoise.
E.
द्रुण to go, to hurt, affixes कि and ङीष्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Quick or swift.
2 Melted, fused.
3 Liquid, fluid.
4 Flown, escaped, run away.
5 Scattered, diffused.
m. (-तः)
A tree.
n. (-तं)
Quick time, (in music,)
adv. n. (-तं)
Quickly, swiftly.
E.
द्र to go, affix क्त.

n. subs. (-दं)
A quick pace or step.
adv.
Quickly.
E.
द्रुत, and पद a step.

m. (-खः)
A thorn.
E.
द्रु a tree, and नख nail.

m. (-हः)
A scabbard: see द्रुणह.

m. (-मः)
1 A tree in general.
2 A tree of Svarga or paradise.
3 A name of KUVERA.
E.
द्रु to go, म aff.

m. (-खः)
A thorn.
E.
द्रुम a tree, and नस्व a finger nail: see द्रुनख.

m. (-रः)
A thorn.
E.
द्रुम a tree, रम to sport, affix ड.

m. (-धिः)
Lac.
E.
द्रुम, and व्याधि disease.

n. (-र्षं)
The upper part of a building or wall.
E.
द्रुम a tree, and शीर्ष a head, resembling the top of a tree.

m. (-ष्ठः)
The palm tree: see ताल.
E.
द्रुम a tree, and श्रेष्ठ best.

m. (-यः)
Lac, the animal dye.
E.
द्रुम a tree, and आमत्र sickness.

m. (-रिः)
An elephant.
E.
द्रुम, and अरि a foe.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Sheltering or dwelling in trees.
E.
द्रुन, and आश्रय abode.

m. (-रः)
1 The palm tree: see ताल.
2 The moon.
E.
द्रुम a tree, and ईश्वर sovereign.

m. (-लः)
A plant: see कर्णिकार.
E.
द्रुम a tree, and उत्पल a lotus, to which the flowers are compared.

n. (-यं)
Measure in general.
E.
द्रु a tree, and वय affix, implying measure.

n. (-कः)
A tree, (Chironjia sapida.)
E.
द्रु a thing or substance, सल्लका the olibanum plant; a resinous plant.

m. (ध्रुक्)
An injurer.
E.
द्रुह to hate, affix क्विप्.

r. 4th cl. (द्रुह्यति)
To bear hatred, to seek to hurt or injure.

m. (-णः)
A name of BRAHMĀ: see the next.

m. (-णः)
A name of BRAHMĀ.
E.
द्रुह to injure or hurt, (the wicked,) and इनन् affix, or द्रु a tree, (figuratively the universe,) हन to destroy, इनि affix, destroyer of the world; न changed to ण; also द्रुहण.

mfn. (-ह्यन्-ह्यन्ती-ह्यत्)
1 Attacking, assailing, defying.
2 Tyrannising over, oppressing.
E.
द्रुह to hate, शतृ aff.
